mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_tool_version SET exposed_name = #{exposedName}, implementation_key = #{implementationKey}, mcp_server_version_id = #{mcpServerVersionId}, remote_tool_name = #{remoteToolName}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tool_id = #{toolId} AND tool_version_id = #{toolVersionId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT v.tool_version_id, v.tool_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.revision, v.published_at, v.exposed_name, v.implementation_key, v.mcp_server_version_id, v.remote_tool_name FROM squad_chat.sq_tool_version v JOIN squad_chat.sq_tool t ON t.tool_id = v.tool_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server_version mv ON mv.mcp_server_version_id = v.mcp_server_version_id LEFT JOIN squad_chat.sq_mcp_server m ON m.mcp_server_id = mv.mcp_server_id WHERE v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.status = 'ENABLED' AND (v.mcp_server_version_id IS NULL OR (mv.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND m.status = 'ENABLED')) ORDER BY v.exposed_name, v.version_no DESC, v.tool_version_id
